errors.text_span: Тази стълбовидна диаграма показва разпределението на фирмите с печалба над средната за отрасъла според възприетите от тях ценови стратегии.
errors.evidence: The description states that the chart shows the "distribution of companies with above-average profit... according to their... pricing strategies." This phrasing incorrectly implies that the bars represent parts of a single population (i.e., that the percentages would sum to 100%). However, the chart actually shows three independent proportions. Based on the caption ("Share of companies that have adopted the respective pricing strategy, for which profit is above the industry average"), each bar represents the percentage of companies *within that specific strategy group* that have above-average profits. For example, 31.7% of companies using a value-based strategy have above-average profits. The description misinterprets these independent, within-group percentages as a between-group distribution of a single population.
